meta.name: zero-tech-debt
meta.description: Rework a patch from its intended end-state, not from the historical path that produced it — delete compat cruft, mode flags, fallbacks, and wrappers no one calls anymore. Triggers "zero tech debt", "rewrite as if from scratch", "delete the compat layer", "kill the legacy path", "this has too many flags", or when a feature has accreted mode props and shims over multiple iterations and you want the shape it should have shipped with.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码，清理遗留兼容层和废弃包装
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的项目积累了大量兼容性代码和废弃标志
copy.tagline_en: Rework code by clearing legacy compat layers and dead wrappers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated many compatibility layers and deprecated flags

howto.what: Claude会以最终目标为起点重构代码，删除兼容层、模式标志和无人调用的回退代码，只保留真正需要的部分。
howto.when: 当你提到“zero tech debt”“删除兼容层”等关键词，或某个功能在多次迭代中积累了过多模式标志、别名或兼容包装时触发。

say.text: 清理这个模块的遗留代码，只保留实际调用的接口。
say.note: Claude会搜索调用者并删除无用兼容层。

say.text: 把这个补丁按照它本应交付的样子重写。
say.note: Claude会从最终状态出发重构，忽略历史路径。

say.text: 删除这个功能的所有模式标志和回退分支。
say.note: Claude会删除无调用者的分支并重塑代码。

howto.what_en: Claude reworks code from the intended end-state, deleting compat cruft, mode flags, fallbacks, and wrappers with no callers, keeping only what's needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords like "zero tech debt" or "delete the compat layer", or when a feature has accumulated mode props, route aliases, or shims over iterations.

say_en.text: Clean up legacy code in this module, keep only interfaces that are actually called.
say_en.note: Claude greps for callers and deletes unused compat layers.

say_en.text: Rewrite this patch as it should have shipped from the start.
say_en.note: Claude reworks from the end-state, ignoring historical path.

say_en.text: Remove all mode flags and fallback branches from this feature.
say_en.note: Claude deletes branches with no callers and reshapes code.
